hypothesis: Concentrating next-flat execution authority in bidirectional Hulk/BTC and canonical HYPE-breakout/HYPE while retaining all other providers as observers may improve after-cost portfolio evidence and avoid negative or unreviewed route displacement.
decision: Preserve v9 as a separate inactive next-flat candidate. It executes only Hulk/BTC and canonical HYPE-breakout/HYPE, keeps both directions, retains the current HYPE eight-to-24-hour extension contract, raises canonical HYPE to $75, and leaves every other provider-symbol pair observe-only. Do not stage, restart, or activate while the current HYPE lifecycle is open.
falsifier: Profile-matched HYPE PF at or below one over twenty to thirty closes, Hulk/BTC negative after-cost PnL or PF at or below one over ten to twenty closes, a material missed-opportunity advantage from an observe-only route, or any scope, lifecycle, protection, ownership, or telemetry mismatch falsifies the portfolio candidate.
limitations: Neither executable mechanism has enough mutually independent live evidence to establish durable edge.
HYPE live outcomes contradict the negative deployed-shape historical replay.
Hulk BTC has only two resolved live trades and contradictory historical blocks.
Observe-only routes may recover before the next manual review; missed-opportunity telemetry is therefore required.
The candidate is neither staged nor active and has no signing authority.
